messages.content: "Could you please analyze my personality based on the five-factor model and the Myers-Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI)? For the five-factor model, consider that I am quite talkative, I don't get nervous easily, I have many artistic interests, I am not lazy, and I am quite forgiving. For the MBTI, my preferences are more towards feeling than thinking, I am more extroverted than introverted, I lean more towards perceiving than judging, and I prefer intuition over sensing."

function.name: MBTI_analyse
function.description: Analyse personality based on the Myers-Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI) which sorts for preferences and generates a 4-letter personality type. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

thinking_vs_feeling.description: Preference of user between thinking and feeling.

introverted_vs_extroverted.description: Preference of user between introverted and extroverted.

judging_vs_perceiving.description: Preference of user between judging and perceiving.

sensing_vs_intuition.description: Preference of user between sensing and intuition.

function.name: five_factor_model_analyse
function.description: Analyse personality based on the five-factor model, also known as the Big Five, which measures openness, conscientiousness, extraversion, agreeableness, and neuroticism. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

talkative.description: Indicates if the user is talkative.

nervous.description: Indicates if the user gets nervous easily.

artistic_interests.description: Indicates if the user has many artistic interests.

lazy.description: Indicates if the user tends to be lazy.

forgiving.description: Indicates if the user is forgiving.
